newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Asia Product Swaps - Fuel oil, gas oil collapse.
newsitem.headline: Asia Product Swaps - Fuel oil, gas oil collapse.

text.p: The bottom fell out of the Singapore fuel oil and gas oil swaps market late afternoon on Tuesday as strong selling pressure sent both markets below key support points, traders said.
"There is some panic selling (for both products) because hopes of some new prompt regional demand is fading quickly and more supplies are coming on the market," one trader said.
The front-month gas oil swaps was offered below $26.00 per barrel with fuel oil swaps breaking the $100.00 per tonne mark in active trading, brokers said.
Both markets are steeped in contango in a clear reflection of the extremely weak market fundamentals.
February fuel oil swaps offer were last quoted at $98.00 a tonne, down from midday's $100.50 selling price, one broker said. The market traded at $97.50 a tonne, he said.
March offers were quoted at $99.00 per tonne from an earlier $101.50, the broker said.
The February/March time spread traded this morning at minus $1.00 a tonne, compared with Monday's minus 75 cents trade.

Traders said the high stock levels in Hong Kong and China where some storage terminals were reporting "tank top" situation and talks of defaults in China are sending prices of both gas oil and fuel oil plunging.

Gas oil swaps were also sold sharply lower with February last offered at $25.65 per barrel from an earlier $26.10/$26.30 Monday. February traded earlier at between $26.50 and $26.15 for at least 300,000 barrels, one broker said.
March was quoted at $26.10/$26.30, down from $26.60/$26.80.
The February/March gas oil contango widened to last quote at minus 40/20 cents.
